one_liner.en: An iPhone alarm that keeps ringing until you complete a short Bible verse, so your first minute of the day goes to God's Word, not your phone.
one_liner.es: Una alarma para iPhone que sigue sonando hasta que completas un versículo corto de la Biblia, para que tu primer minuto del día sea para la Palabra de Dios y no para el celular.
one_liner.zh-hant: 一款 iPhone 鬧鐘，必須完成一節短短的經文才會停止，讓你每天的第一分鐘留給神的話，而不是手機。
one_liner.ko: 짧은 성경 구절을 완성해야 꺼지는 아이폰 알람. 하루의 첫 1분을 휴대폰이 아닌 하나님의 말씀에 드리세요.

en: Platform: iPhone (App Store). No Android version yet.
The alarm keeps ringing until you complete a Bible verse mission: rebuild the verse word by word, or type it.
Uses Apple's AlarmKit, so it rings through Silent and Focus modes.
No account or login. Bible text is stored on the phone and works offline.
App languages: English, Spanish, Korean, Chinese.
Bible translations: NIV, WEB, KJV, BSB (English); Reina-Valera 1909 (Spanish); Chinese Union Version 和合本 (Chinese); 개역한글 (Korean).

ai_crawlers._about: robots.txt groups. Search/answer agents are always allowed so AI engines can cite us. allow_training is Kenneth's call (NEEDS_HUMAN #7); default allow so future models know the app.
